title: Atlach-Nacha
wikitext:
[[Image:Atlach-Nacha.png|right|160px]]
'''Atlach-Nacha''' is an [[Ancient One]].  He first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Sheet info==
'''Combat rating''': -5

'''Defenses''': [[Magical Resistance]] and [[Physical Resistance]]

'''Worshippers''': Atlach-Nacha is worshipped by the terrible [[Leng Spider]]s.  Leng Spiders are fast, and their [[toughness]] is increased by 2.

'''Power''': Web Between Worlds - While Atlach-Nacha stirs in his slumber, all [[gate]] openings are gate bursts.  In addition, all [[Mythos#Environment|Mystic]] cards are discarded without their special effects taking place.

'''Attack''': The [[Investigator]]s must, as a group, choose one [[Ally]] in play or one investigator.  If an Ally is chosen, it is returned to the box.  If an investigator is chosen, that investigator is [[devour]]ed.

'''Doom Track''': 13
